description.narrative: (Cote d'Ivoire): The Political Transition and Inclusion (PTI) activity is designed to reinforce Ivoirians' efforts to strengthen inclusion and democratic processes as firewalls to further violence and instability, and to help local and national institutions gain the legitimacy and inclusivity needed to achieve sustained reconciliation and participatory democracy. 2020 is an election year in which PTI is paying particular attention to the electoral process, as much at the local as national levels, to ensure a peaceful and inclusive environment..FY 2020 funds will support youth and women participation during the presidential election period, including helping political parties to become more inclusive. Funds will support media activities through national and local debates. Citizen-driven domestic observation efforts under parallel vote tabulation (PVT) will enhance the transparency and credibility of the presidential election and promote peaceful participation among youth, women, and marginalized populations..PTI will provide technical assistance to 15 communities at risk of conflict in Abidjan and the central, northern and western regions of the country, using participatory and research-driven processes to mitigate risks to peaceful elections and to social cohesion, and reduce vulnerability to violent extremism. Women, youth and grass-roots communities will benefit from new economic opportunities and social entrepreneurship as owners, customers, beneficiaries and citizens. This activity contributes directly to the ICS Strategic Objective 1.2: (CdI advances internal and regional stability to include modernizing and professionalizing security services)............. .... .
